text: Trainline plc has been listed on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market since 26 June 2019 (ticker TRN); per notifications as at 25 September 2026 its largest holders are FIL Limited (14.32%), BlackRock (6.15%), JPMorgan Asset Management (5.72%), Aviva (5.35%), J.P. Morgan Securities (5.05%) and Ninety One (5.04%) - all asset managers and insurers, with no state or sovereign-fund holder.

source.name: Trainline plc - Major shareholders (investor relations)
source.quote: As at 25 September 2026, the Company had been notified of the following direct or indirect interests of its share capital: Shareholder Voting rights (%) FIL Limited 14.32% BlackRock, Inc. 6.15%

additionalSources.name: Trainline plc IPO Prospectus
additionalSources.quote: When admitted to trading, the Shares will be registered with ISIN number GB00BKDTK925 and SEDOL number BKDTK92 and trade under the symbol “TRN”.
additionalSources.note: Admission to the LSE Main Market was expected to become effective on 26 June 2019 (prospectus, page 5).
